title: finding(plugin-detail): `RelatedList` draws a hand-rolled em-dash instead of the shared `EmptyValue`, so half its empty cells carry no `aria-label`
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8459. Filed unassigned, ⛔ not claimed. Out of that card's fence: that card converges the two **predicates** (when is a cell empty); this is about what the placeholder **is** once the predicate says yes. ## What `@object-ui/components` exports `EmptyValue`, described in its own docblock as the "universal inline placeholder for missing cell/field values — use this anywhere a renderer would otherwise show `-` or `—`". It renders: ```html — ``` `RelatedList.makeCell` does not use it. It builds its own: ```ts React.createElement('span', { className: 'text-muted-foreground/50 text-xs italic' }, '—') ``` Captured from a real rendered grid (`origin/main` a407bd654): ```html
—
``` No `data-slot`, no `aria-label`, no `select-none` / `pointer-events-none`, plus `text-xs italic` that the shared one does not have. ## Why it matters **Both placeholders appear in the same grid, on the same screen.** `makeCell`'s branch runs first and intercepts the values it recognises; anything it passes through reaches a type-aware renderer that has its own empty branch and returns `EmptyValue`. Several of those branches are reachable with values `makeCell` does not classify as empty — e.g. `DateCellRenderer` returns `EmptyValue` for an unparseable date (`if (date === null || isNaN(date.getTime()))`), and `ImageCellRenderer` for `imgs.length === 0`. So two cells in the same column can both read "empty" to a sighted user while only one of them is announced to a screen reader, and they are not visually identical either (italic + `text-xs` on one). `DetailSection` has the same split on the record page: its own em-dash branch is hand-rolled too, but *that* one at least carries `aria-label={t('detail.noValue')}` and a `title`. `RelatedList`'s carries neither — it is the only one of the three with no accessible name at all. ## Suggested shape Have `RelatedList.makeCell` return `` (already a dependency — `@object-ui/components` is a peer). If the `text-xs italic` treatment is wanted in a dense grid, `EmptyValue` accepts `className`, so it can be kept without forking the component or losing the label. ⚠️ Worth checking whether any pin asserts the current class string before changing it, and whether the localized `No value` label is the right announcement for a grid cell (`DetailSection` uses `detail.noValue`). ## Evidence level The `RelatedList` DOM above is **measured** (captured from a rendered grid). The claim that a renderer's own `EmptyValue` branch is reachable from a surviving related-list column is **read from source** (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`), not driven end-to-end — worth one measurement before acting. ## Dedup Searched `objectstack-ai/objectui` via MCP `search_issues` (REST is 403 from the dev container): `RelatedList EmptyValue placeholder em-dash aria-label inconsistent hand-rolled span`. Returned objectui#8459 (control hit — the readings are real), objectui#8279 and objectui#8394; none covers this.
